c.tagline: Mexico's soul of mezcal, mole, and Zapotec craft, wrapped around a golden colonial core.

taxi.color: varies (often white and red, or blue)
taxi.fareNote: Oaxaca street taxis are unmetered; agree the fare before getting in, or use Uber/DiDi to see the price up front.

emergency.note: 911 is Mexico's unified nationwide emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance.

hood_landmark.Centro Histórico: Templo de Santo Domingo de Guzmán, Oaxaca

avoid.reason: Generally safe; occasional protests/road blockades; petty crime at night

hood_desc: The UNESCO-listed colonial core around the Zócalo and the Santo Domingo church, packed with markets, mezcalerías, museums, and most of the city's sights; the best all-around base for a first visit.
A hip, artsy barrio of cobblestone streets, street art, colorful facades, coffee shops, and mezcal bars just a 10-minute walk from the Zócalo; the favorite of couples and creative travelers.
One of the oldest neighborhoods in Latin America, a quieter cultural quarter of aqueduct arches, artisan workshops, and small plazas; ideal for a slower, more local pace.
A largely residential, authentic district just west of Centro where daily life carries on with little thought for tourism; cheaper stays and still a 10-15 minute walk to the Zócalo.
A traditional, budget-friendly barrio south of Centro near the Basílica de la Soledad, with local markets and family-run eateries and fewer crowds.

water.note: Drink bottled or purified water; tap water is not potable.

transit.hours: City buses (urbanos) and colectivos run roughly 5:30 AM to 10:00 PM; after that, taxis and ride apps fill the gap.
transit.note: Oaxaca has no metro or tram; the compact Centro is best explored on foot, with city buses, shared colectivo taxis, and app or street taxis for longer hops.
transit.pay: Bus and colectivo fares are paid in cash to the driver (roughly 9-12 pesos); there is no rechargeable transit card.

bus: ADO / OCC / AU first-class intercity buses
Colectivos to the Valles Centrales villages

transit.m: Prepaid airport taxi to Centro (buy the ticket at the kiosk inside; 20-25 min, zone-based fare)
Shared colectivo van (transportación terrestre) to Centro

tip.r: 10-15% is standard at restaurants; round up for taxis and leave a little for hotel and tour staff.
